headline: 鬼玩人炼狱领跑热搜，蜘蛛侠新作紧随
headlineEn: Evil Dead: Purgatory tops trends, Spider-Man follows
summary: 今日影视热搜由《鬼玩人：炼狱》和《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》领跑；本周新片共4部，今日暂无新片上映，热度集中在超级英雄与经典IP。接下来《最后的日出》《OK老板娘2》《逃出绝命街》即将登场。
summaryEn: Evil Dead: Purgatory and Spider-Man: Brand New Day lead today's entertainment trends. Four new movies arrive this week, with none released today. Upcoming titles include The Last Sunrise, OK Boss Lady 2, and Escape from Doom Street.

industryHighlights.en: 4 new movies hit screens this week

industryHighlights.text: 《最后的日出》《OK老板娘2》《逃出绝命街》即将上映
industryHighlights.en: The Last Sunrise, OK Boss Lady 2, and Escape from Doom Street are upcoming

industryHighlights.text: 超级英雄与经典IP占据热搜主流
industryHighlights.en: Superhero titles and classic IPs dominate trending charts

industryHighlights.text: 《超级少女》《龙族》等剧集持续升温
industryHighlights.en: Supergirl and House of the Dragon continue to gain momentum
